display_long_description:
Cavebound is a charming, casual social adventure where players team up to explore a whimsical underground world, mine glittering crystals, and uncover hidden treasures. Dive into cozy, vibrant caves alongside your goofy mole companions—or meet new friends along the way—as you dig deep and reveal the secrets buried below.

With its colorful, inviting art style and relaxing gameplay, Cavebound offers a stress-free escape perfect for players of all ages. Work together to gather resources, discover rare gems, or just relax in the colorful environments. Explore with friends, mine or find colorful treasures, or simply enjoy the serene beauty of the underground—there’s no pressure, just pure, laid-back fun!

Whether you're playing solo or teaming up for cooperative mining expeditions, Cavebound blends light exploration, social interaction, and satisfying collection mechanics into a delightful experience. Unearth ancient relics and uncover the mysteries hidden beneath the surface. Will you strike it rich with a legendary crystal? Or will you focus on creating the most stylish mole in the underground? The choice is yours!

Perfect for short play sessions or longer, leisurely adventures, Cavebound is a heartwarming game about friendship, discovery, and the joy of digging just a little deeper. Grab your drills, rally your mole pals, and let’s explore!
